Specifies the signal to respond to. This module supports the standard
Linux signals. Configuring an action uses the standard name of the
signal.
For example, to configure an action to SIGUSR1, the value for the
Signal element is SIGUSR1. To configure an action for SIGHUP, the
value for the Signal element is SIGHUP and so on.
AMPS reserves SIGQUIT for producing minidumps and does not allow
this module to override SIGQUIT. AMPS registers actions for several
